subject: 20m: walk through inference burst + cost controls
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@brightatlas.com>
Cc:  
Date: Fri, 7 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 20m to walk your recent inference burst?

Hi Daniel —

I noticed BrightAtlas crossed one of our self-serve usage thresholds this morning (nice ramp — congrats). We often see small configuration tweaks and a short runbook that can reduce cost and smooth latency during bursts.

Would you be open to a focused 20-minute session so I can: 1) see the usage pattern, 2) suggest a couple quick config/batching changes, and 3) share a short ops runbook you can keep? No sales pitch — just practical fixes you can apply right away.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Mon Jul 10 — 10:00–10:20
- Mon Jul 10 — 14:00–14:20
- Tue Jul 11 — 09:30–09:50

If none work, send a couple times that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ll include our AE and Solutions Engineer so we have context for pricing or quota questions.

Agenda (20m):
- 5m: quick context + goals
- 10m: targeted config and batching suggestions
- 5m: next steps + runbook access

Attachments: short runbook stub I’ll bring to the call.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
SDR, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood_runbook_20min.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@brightatlas.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightAtlas Ops <ops@brightatlas.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Jul 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 20m to walk your recent inference burst?

Thanks Grace — this is timely. We did some model-heavy batch jobs last night that caused token spikes and a few user-facing slowdowns. Happy to take 20 minutes. Ops is looped in.

Prefer Tue Jul 11 at 09:30 PDT if that slot is still free. We also have two quick asks for the session: 1) can you cover short-term token-cost mitigations, and 2) confirm what logs you can provide for our audit team?

Best,
Daniel
Head of ML Engineering, BrightAtlas
daniel.kim@brightatlas.com

Thanks for the quick reply — Tue Jul 11 09:30 PDT is available and I’ve tentatively held it. I’m attaching the 2-page runbook we’ll use in the session so your team can preview.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Token-cost mitigations: we’ll show 3 levers (batching cadence, prefix/KV cache usage, and a simple rerank-before-generation filter) you can try in minutes.
- Logs/audit: we can export per-request latency and token breakdowns and provide a one-off CSV for your audit team; if you need continuous exports we’ll discuss options with our AE.

I’ve looped in Mina (Solutions Engineer) so we can show a brief config diff if helpful.

Calendly (if you prefer self-pick): https://calendly.com/redwood/grace-20m

See you Tue —
Grace
